name: Joseph Stones House
address: St Cecilia Street, Leeds LS2 7PA, United Kingdom
about:
Studying at Leeds Conservatoire? Joseph Stones House is a purpose-built student accommodation in Leeds, ideally located in the artistic Quarry Hill Cultural Quarter in the heart of Leeds city centre, close to campus and within walking distance of classes. Unite Students Joseph Stones House can accommodate 190 students in various flexible room types. With a comfortable communal lounge area with pool table, study table, TV and complimentary tea and coffee, Joseph Stones House Leeds is the ideal space to study and relax, and is surrounded by a wealth of cultural resources, close to the University of Leeds and Leeds Beckett University, and within a few minutes walk of renowned arts organisations, such as the Northern Ballet, the Leeds Theatre and the BBC Yorkshire, providing students with a vibrant environment in which to explore the arts.
 
Nearby Universities
Joseph Stones House is in close proximity to Leeds College of Music and other universities, which are also within walking distance, making it easy for students to commute to campus.Leeds Conservatoire: 3-minute walkLeeds Beckett University: 20-minute walkUniversity of Leeds: 20-minute walk
 
Features
Each room at Joseph Stones House is equipped with a private bathroom to ensure privacy and ease of everyday life. You will find a double bed. There is also a private kitchenette for self-catering. A wardrobe provides plenty of storage space. In addition, a desk and chair create a cosy study area, creating an ideal study environment and helping to focus on your studies.
 
Unite Students Joseph Stones House offers many shared facilities. These features help to create a social and engaging atmosphere. The spacious common room is equipped with sofas, a TV and a wide range of tabletop games, providing the ideal place for students to relax and socialise. Free tea and coffee are available to make everyone feel at home after a busy day. Dedicated study areas with a quiet environment help to complete academic tasks efficiently. For your convenience, there is bicycle storage and on-site laundry facilities. The rent includes bills for water, electricity, contents insurance, Wi-Fi, and heating.
 
Location and What's Hot?
Joseph Stones House is conveniently located in the centre of Leeds, within walking distance of a variety of dining and shopping venues. Start your day with a fresh cup of coffee at the nearby Teapot Café. For those who like to be outdoors, St Mary's Park is less than half a mile away, and Lincoln Green Shopping Centre offers a wide range of shops, making it a great place for casual shopping. There are also a number of speciality restaurants in the vicinity, such as Bundobust, which serves Indian street food, and Real Burger Inc., which specialises in American burgers, catering for all tastes. When relaxing, choose The Dry Dock pub or Mr Tea for a pleasant gathering with friends. In addition, renowned arts venues such as Northern Ballet, BBC Yorkshire, Yorkshire Dance, Leeds Playhouse, Red Ladder Theatre Company and Gallery at 164 are also close by, making staying here a great cultural experience.
 
Transport
Joseph Stones House is conveniently located above campus, making travelling easy and convenient. There are several bus stops within a few minutes' walk, such as Cultural D and Cultural E, which are only a 3-minute walk away. It's also easy to get to Leeds Travel Terminal, Leeds' main transport hub, which is about a 0.8-mile walk away. The commute is smooth whether you're travelling to class or exploring the city.

name: Hepworth Lodge
address: 19 Marlborough Street, Leeds LS1 4LA, United Kingdom
about: Hepworth Lodge is a modern student accommodation in Leeds, offering ensuites and studio rooms. Located at 19 Marlborough Street, Leeds LS1 4LA, Hepworth Lodge Leeds is just a 10-minute walk from Leeds city centre and provides an array of buzzing nightlife, bars, restaurants, shops and two multi-screen cinemas. The accommodation is great for students studying in Leeds, near the University of Leeds, Leeds Beckett University and Leeds Conservatoire. It has a modern and stylish design with excellent facilities and security systems designed for student living. Unite Students - Hepworth Lodge is also near Leeds Central train station and offers easy access to transport links, ensuring seamless travel around the city. FeaturesUnite Students - Hepworth Lodge offers Premium Range 1 En-Suite, Classic En-Suite, Premium Range 1 Accessible Studio and Premium Range 1 Studio. Equipment in the kitchen includes a fridge, oven, microwave, hoover, iron and ironing board. The bathroom has a shower unit, wash hand basin, mirror, toilet seat and towel rack. Hepworth Lodge Leeds also offers spacious communal areas where students can relax and make friends.Laundry RoomOutdoor social spaceVending machine Bike StorageReceptionTable TennisGame RoomSurface Parking Lot Location and What's Hot?Hepworth Lodge Leeds is a very convenient place to live, and there is a Chinese restaurant, a pizzeria and several western restaurants within 5 minutes walking distance. There are also a number of hotels, such as the Hotel Ibis Leeds Centre, and several banks close by. The nearest supermarket, Co-operative Food, is only a 10-minute walk away, making it very convenient for shopping. With convenient access to nearby bus stops like West Street and Leeds City College, getting around the city is simple and efficient. For longer journeys, both Leeds Station and Burley Park Station are within a 10-minute walk, making train travel in and out of the city highly accessible. Thanks to these well-placed transport links, students living at this accommodation near the University of Leeds can explore the city with ease.14 minutes walk to the University of Leeds14 minutes walk to Leeds Beckett University14 minutes by public transport to Leeds College of Art17 minutes walk to the University of Leeds Business School17 minutes walk to the School of Education, University of Leeds21 minutes walk to the School of Mechanical Engineering, University of Leeds Security & ServicesHepworth Lodge Leeds electronically gated and accessible and offer 24/7 security and maintenance services via the free app. An emergency command centre is available 24 hours a day, seven days a week, to help students with emergency issues. The flats are also covered by a superfast internet connection, which students can use for free. This Leeds student accommodation also have a shared lounge with regular social events, allowing students to relax, make friends and integrate easily into local studies and life.

name: Burley Studios

about: Burley Studios is a brand-new premium student accommodation in Leeds at 2 Burley Street, LS3 1FP, with top location, stylish studios, and brilliant social spaces. It is just a 15-minute walk to the University of Leeds and Leeds Beckett University, and 7 minutes to Leeds City College, designed for students to enjoy 100% private life while stay close to campus. Every room at Burley Studio is a fully self-contained studio with a private kitchen, en-suite bathroom, and in-room washer/dryer for ultimate privacy and convenience. Enjoy all-bills-included (gas, electric, water), 250Mbps ultrafast WiFi, contents insurance, a fully equipped gym, social lounge, coffee bar, private dining, and regular events. With 24/7 support and a vibrant yet peaceful community, it’s perfect for students wanting independence without missing out on student life. Enjoy a true “walk-everywhere” lifestyle that keeps your student routine stress-free and vibrant.Universities: Leeds City College Park Lane Campus is just 0.1 miles away (2 min walk), University of Leeds approx. 0.6 miles (13-15 min walk), Leeds Beckett University 0.7 miles (14-15 min walk), and BPP University / University of Law Leeds within 10-16 min walk.Shopping & Markets: Head to city centre malls like Trinity Leeds (0.8 miles) and Victoria Leeds / Victoria Gate (1.1 miles) in 15-25 minutes on foot, with local markets and convenience shops just a few minutes away.Restaurants & Drinks: A vibrant food scene surrounds LUNA Burley Studios, walk 5-8 minutes to spots like MyLahore (authentic Pakistani), Manjaros (Caribbean flavours), Archive (great coffee and brunch), and Haftsin (Persian cuisine), plus the full city centre dining and nightlife within 15 minutes.Supermarkets: Grab essentials easily with Co-op Food (3 min), Tesco Express (11 min) and Sainsbury’s Local (14 min) with a short stroll, while larger options like Aldi or Asda are a quick bus ride.TransportBurley Studios Leeds offers outstanding transport links. Nearby bus stops like Leeds City College (2 min walk) and St Andrews Street (5 min walk) are just steps away, plus on-site bike storage for eco-friendly commutes. Leeds Train Station is under a 15-minute walk, with seamless UK-wide rail connections. Leeds Bradford Airport is about 7.3 miles away (~25-35 min by car/taxi, or via Flyer airport bus + train combo). Get to classes, the city, or weekend trips effortlessly, ideal for international students!
